approach: The wave speed is the ratio of the angular frequency to the wave number read from the wave equation.

steps.text: Read the wave number and angular frequency from the equation.
steps.equation: y = 0.02 sin(πx − 8πt)  ⟹  k = π rad m⁻¹, ω = 8π rad s⁻¹

common_mistakes.text: Multiplying the coefficients 8π and π instead of dividing, or misreading 8π as the wave speed directly, which gives 16 ms⁻¹.
